career_ladder.note: Engineering Executive Trainees (EETs) in NTPC Limited undergo 1 year of structured intensive training at Power Management Institute (PMI) and operational super thermal power projects. Upon successful completion of training, they are regularized as Assistant Manager in Executive Grade E-1 (₹40,000–₹1,40,000) and progress through the executive management ladder based on residency periods, annual performance management ratings, and DPC evaluations.

exam_scheme.note: Selection for Engineering Executive Trainees in NTPC is conducted 100% on the basis of Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering (GATE) performance in the corresponding engineering paper, followed by Document Verification and Pre-Employment Medical Examination. In adherence to DoPT recruitment guidelines, interviews have been dispensed with for EET recruitment.

financial_package.note: Compensation is governed by DPE 3rd Pay Revision Committee (PRC) guidelines for Maharatna CPSEs. Engineering Executive Trainees receive starting basic pay of ₹40,000 in Grade E-1 (scale ₹40,000–₹1,40,000), mandatory 58% DA constant as of 2025-07-01, cafeteria approach allowances @ 35% of basic pay, project allowance for power station postings, HRA (9% to 27%) or power project township quarters, performance-related pay (PRP), CPF, and medical benefits. Approximate annual Cost to Company (CTC) is ₹14.50 Lakhs.
financial_package.pay_source_label: NTPC EET Emoluments & Terms of Appointment
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated on Entry Basic Pay of ₹40,000, 58% IDA (₹23,200), Cafeteria perks @ 35% (₹14,000), and HRA (9% to 27% = ₹3,600 to ₹10,800), less statutory deductions for Contributory Provident Fund (12% of Basic + DA = ₹7,584), Defined Contribution Pension Scheme, and income tax.
official_perks: Industrial Dearness Allowance (IDA) revised quarterly per AICPI
Perks and Allowances under Cafeteria Approach @ 35% of Basic Pay
Project Allowance / Thermal Power Station Allowance for site and plant postings
House Rent Allowance (HRA) @ 9%, 18%, or 27% / Township residential accommodation in NTPC power colonies
Performance Related Pay (PRP) linked to station generation targets and MoU ratings
Contributory Provident Fund (CPF), Gratuity, and Defined Contribution Pension Scheme
Comprehensive medical treatment for employee and dependent family members in NTPC project hospitals and empaneled healthcare centers
Group Personal Accident Insurance and Group Life Insurance coverage
